name: claudeconnect
notes: Remote is live: your computer streams its screen to the page, up to 30 pictures a second, instead of the page asking for one picture at a time. The page says when it has each one, so a slow connection gets fewer pictures but never late ones, and a screen that isn't changing sends nothing.
What you do over the picture goes back on the same connection, straight away and in order.

On a Mac, the screen is streamed with ScreenCaptureKit through a small helper the Mac builds the first time, if Apple's command line tools are installed (they're never installed or asked for by themselves). Without them it uses ffmpeg if that's there, and otherwise takes pictures one at a time as before, each one already being taken while the last is on its way. On Linux ffmpeg streams it; on Windows the next picture is taken while the last is on its way.
The ? button is gone from Remote.
